A1.T18.caption: Table 18 : Head-to-head pipeline comparison: Claude Code vs. Codex .
rows: 12–15 named sections. Static prefix (identity, rules, tools) cached via Blake2b hash; dynamic suffix (env, memory, MCP) recomputed per-turn. SYSTEM_PROMPT_DYNAMIC_BOUNDARY separates the two.

Per-model prompts as server-delivered catalog data ( models.json base_instructions , remote-refreshed with bundled fallback); personality-templated. AGENTS.md injected via root-to-cwd concatenation (nested content appended last).
43 tools, but only a subset loaded initially. Deferred tools discovered on-demand via ToolSearchTool (keyword search + select: syntax). Reduces prompt tokens by ~40%.
25–30 built-ins; schemas converted to OpenAI Function format via create_tools_json_for_responses_api() . Deferred loading now mirrored: defer_loading flags (MCP tools by default) + BM25 tool_search .
Anthropic Messages API. SSE streaming with content_block_{start,delta,stop} events. Extended thinking via budget_tokens .

OpenAI Responses API. WebSocket primary, SSE fallback. Connection prewarm ( generate=false ). Turn state via x-codex-turn-state header. Reasoning effort (minimal–xhigh, plus max/ultra; ultra adds automatic delegation).
partitionToolCalls() : single-pass reduce partitions by isConcurrencySafe() . Consecutive safe tools batched; unsafe tools solo. Max 10 concurrent via semaphore.
FuturesOrdered through a dedicated ToolCallRuntime ; per-tool supports_parallel flag (default false) gates an execution lock—concurrency-unsafe tools run exclusively.
3 layers: (1) PreToolUse hooks (static pattern match), (2) LLM risk classifier, (3) interactive dialog. Sub-agents skip layer 3.
4 layers: (1) ExecPolicy Starlark rules, (2) lifecycle hooks ( Claude Code -compatible vocabulary), (3) Guardian LLM approval reviewer (fail-closed), (4) OS-level sandbox enforcement.
Host execution with an opt-in OS sandbox (Anthropic sandbox-runtime : Bubblewrap/Seatbelt, network restrictions, dangerouslyDisableSandbox escape hatch); git worktrees for branch isolation.
Sandboxed execution. Vendored Bubblewrap (Linux; Landlock legacy fallback), Seatbelt (macOS), restricted tokens (Windows).

Triggered when remaining context drops below AUTOCOMPACT_BUFFER_TOKENS (13 K), with an env-overridable percent threshold. Image stripping, message grouping by API round, LLM summarization, SystemCompactBoundaryMessage . Post-cleanup: restore 5 files (50 K token budget).
model_auto_compact_token_limit configurable. Local or cloud compaction via /responses/compact ; rollout token budgets with turn aborts.
